correctness.rationale: Enumerating all 16-vertex graph independent sets for step differences 1,4,8 yields full f=(16,80,144,80). Removing translated orbit of 16 tetrahedra leaves core f=(16,80,128,64), every core triangle degree two, and all 16 vertex links have f=(10,24,16), connected and edge-degree two: hence sphere links, plus connected dual graph gives closed 3-manifold. The explicitly listed nine-tetra dual walk has required orientation ratio product -1, obstructing orientation. Independent exact integer Smith computations on reconstructed ∂2,∂3 give for core 1^64 and (1^63,2) and for full 1^65,1^79, proving H1(core)=Z,H2(core)=Z/2,H3(core)=0 and H3(full)=Z. Direct integer nullspace yields primitive full 3-cycle coefficient magnitudes 1 on 64 core facets, 2 on 16 belt facets; relative 16-cycle boundary has 15 unit factors and zero. LES realizes H3(full)->H3(K,M) by ×2 and mod-two quotient. Ambient K≃S³ uses independently published shellability. This finite classification was independently enumerated and Smith-tested; source verifier inspected, not executed. No core fundamental group/homeomorphism identification claimed.
